notes: schedule.json is the authoritative daily calendar for both students.
Every date contains explicit diya.tasks and hamzah.tasks arrays.
Diya ramps from about 70 questions/day in early October to 90, 105, 115, and about 125 questions/day in the AAMC intensive phase; lighter days and full-length/review days override normal targets.
Hamzah chapter_mode=current_unfinished means page.js substitutes the first unfinished chapter from the 58-unit sequence.
Hamzah chapter progression is completion-based, not calendar-based.
Overflow remains separate by student and is handled by page.js.
